framework.summary: The bill requires no safety framework or plan.

transparency_report.summary: Reports go only to the Secretary of Commerce and are shielded from disclosure; no public report is required.

incident_reporting.summary: Covered model developers must send the Secretary of Commerce a detailed report within 7 days of knowing or reasonably believing reportable activity has occurred.
incident_reporting.quote: Not later than 7 days after the date on which a covered model developer knows, or reasonably believes, that reportable activity described in paragraph (2) has occurred related to a covered model, the developer shall submit to the Secretary a report

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: The Secretary must require expedited reports for activity presenting imminent or ongoing risk of serious harm; the bill sets no hour limit.
imminent_risk_reporting.quote: expedited reporting for any reportable activity described in subsection (b)(2) that presents any imminent or ongoing risk of serious harm

third_party_audit.summary: The bill requires no independent audit or evaluation.

whistleblower.summary: The bill has no employee protections.

registration.summary: The Secretary designates covered developers by regulation, but developers need not register or get a license.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown capability; a model resisting shutdown is only a reportable event.

compute_threshold.summary: Coverage is set by Secretary-made capability thresholds, not by a training-compute figure in the bill.

revenue_threshold.summary: Coverage does not depend on revenue, spending or users.

harm_threshold.summary: Reportable activity is defined by type of event and serious risk, with no death, injury or damage figures.

penalties.summary: The Secretary of Commerce may assess a civil penalty up to $2,000,000 for a violation, each day a separate offense; the Attorney General can sue to collect or enjoin.
penalties.quote: the Secretary may assess a civil penalty for a violation of this section in an amount not to exceed $2,000,000

effective_date.summary: The bill states no effective date; deadlines run from enactment.

notes: Covered models and developers, and the exact report window (outer limit 7 days), are set by Commerce regulations due within 180 days of enactment.
